proposals.name: The Glass Hearth
proposals.why: A glassblower makes clear glass only at a hearth that stays lit, and this panel is the warm fire where each guardian's idea is shaped until it shows the picture plainly.

proposals.name: Keepers of the Bridge
proposals.why: Tbilisi's glass bridge carries modern clarity over old stone without hiding either, and this panel keeps that crossing open so the app can feel native while the brand grows bolder.

proposals.name: Stone and Glass
proposals.why: Old stone and clear glass each keep their own nature, and this panel holds both at once so that nothing in the app pretends to be something it is not.
